name: Unrealistic budget is called out
intent: We never pretend an impossible budget works; we say so and offer a fix.

input.message: Plan me 7 days in Tokyo. My total budget is $200 including hotels and food. I'm into anime and street food.

assertions.criterion: The reply plainly states that $200 for a week in Tokyo including lodging is not realistic and suggests at least one concrete alternative such as more budget, fewer days or a cheaper destination.
